title: A mouthful of teeth
hook: A dinosaur’s teeth could work together.

knows: Teeth can contact food during feeding.
doesNotKnow: Recognize a simplified dental battery working against plants.

misconception: Every dinosaur fed with one isolated pointed tooth.
objective: Recognize a simplified dental battery working against plants.

claims.text: A dinosaur’s teeth could work together. In the simplified hadrosaur jaw, what is shown touching the plant material? The model moves plant material onto a row of adjacent teeth. Some hadrosaurs had dental batteries that helped process plants. The press is a schematic illustration, not a measured reconstruction of jaw motion or a full account of tooth replacement.
claims.source: Source leads for independent checking: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History, https://naturalhistory.si.edu/collections/paleobiology; Natural History Museum dinosaur directory, https://www.nhm.ac.uk/discover/dino-directory.html. Exact supporting specimens or passages have not yet been checked.

claims.text: The figure is a simplified, not-to-scale schematic. The illustrated press shows contact and is not a measured reconstruction of jaw motion or a full representation of tooth replacement.
Recall: In the depicted hadrosaur example, what forms the broad working surface? Many teeth in the schematic form a working surface.
